verdict.rationale: Skills for Real Engineers is a bundle of agent skill files written into your repo or installed as a plugin. It is not a hosted service that stores user data, so choosing a storage region or residency is a category error for this kind of product. The option to keep issues in GitHub, Linear, or local files picks an issue-tracker backend, not a data-residency region, and does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
